rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar (AMs) na Wales suna damuwa game da "kama kamar kayan wasan kida"

rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu 'yan majalisar a wani shiri da ake yi na canza taken su zuwa MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ya taso ne saboda shirye-shiryen canza sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Wales.

rows.output: AMs a faɗin fagen siyasa suna damuwa cewa hakan na iya jawo wa su kunya.

rows.output: Wani memba na jam'iyyar Labour ya ce, "muna da damuwa cewa yana da kama da Twp da Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karanta a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh, twp yana nufin daft da pwp yana nufin feces.

rows.output: Wani memba na jam'iyyar Plaid ya ce, "Ba mu yi farin ciki ba," kuma ya ba da shawarar wasu hanyoyin.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Conservative na Wales ya ce kungiyar sa tana da "zuciya mai bude" game da canjin sunan, amma ya lura cewa hakan yana da guntuwar magana daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A wannan mahallin haruffan Welsh w ana furta shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin Yorkshire na Ingilishi.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wadda a halin yanzu tana rubuta dokar gabatar da canje-canje a cikin sunan, ta ce: "Shawaran karshe kan duk wani bayanin abin da ake kira mambobin Majalisar zai dogara ne akan 'yan majalisar kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba wa Majalisar Welsh ikon canza sunan ta.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wani tattaunawa a bainar jama'a kan shawarwarin da suka samu goyon baya mai faɗi na kiran majalisar da Majalisar Welsh.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: A kan batun sunan AMs, hukumar ta fi son mambobin Majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi yawan goyon baya a wani bincike na jama'a.

rows.output: Ana ganin AMs suna ba da wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma ƙalubalen cim ma yarjeji na iya zama damuwa ga Shugaban Majalisar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran ta gabatar da kundin tsarin mulki kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar gyarawa za ta hada da wasu canje-canje ga yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da ka'idojin cire mambobi da kuma tsarin kwamitocin.

rows.output: Coci, ya kara da cewa, za a iya maye gurbinsu da gine-gine na gidan zama da gidan kwale-kwale da cikakkun mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka wa majami'u da suka rage a wannan unguwa ba.

rows.output: "Yawanci mutane da ke sayen gidaje a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance fari ne," ya ce, "sannu kuma za su hanzarta ranar da waɗannan majami'u za su rufe gaba ɗaya saboda ba zai yiwu ba cewa yawancin mutanen da za su koma cikin waɗannan gidaje za su zama mambobin waɗannan majami'u."

rows.output: A matsayin wani ɓangare na babban tashin hankali zuwa kasuwar kyau ta Birtaniya ta £2.8bn, wanda ke ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan ado da kayan gida ke komawa baya, manyan kantunan kyau za a gwada a cikin shaguna 11 a faɗin kasar, kuma za a kai su ƙarin shaguna a shekarar gaba idan ya yi nasara.

rows.output: Kantin sayar da kayan abinci na musamman yana sake fara samar da layin kayan shafawa na Boutique domin yawancin kayan su kasance masu cin ganyayyaki - wani abu da ake samun karbuwa sosai daga masu siye masu shekaru.

rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai sayar da turare, The Fragrance Shop, zai gwada shaguna a cikin shaguna biyu na Sainsbury, na farko da aka bude a Croydon, kudu London, makonnin da suka gabata, yayin da na biyu ya bude a Selly Oak, Birmingham, a karshen wannan shekarar.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya fara sanya wuraren Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna kuma ya gabatar da sabbin wuraren Argos da dama tun da ya sayi duka jerin 'yan kasuwa shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda ya ce ya kara sayar da kayan abinci da kuma sa sayar da kayan aiki ya zama mai riba.

rows.output: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne bayan Sainsbury ta sayar da kasuwancinta na magani 281 ga Celesio, mai Lloyds Pharmacy, akan fam miliyan 125, shekaru uku da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Joko kuma yana fuskantar matsi daga rikicin addini da ya dade a Indonesia, inda mabiya addinin Musulunci na rinjaye suka rungumi wani nau'in addinin da ya fi tsauri.

rows.reference: Fiye da mutane miliyan 20 ne suka kalli shaida mai riƙewa daga wanda aka tura sunan don kujerar Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh da matar da ke ƙararsa a kan cin zarafi na jima’i da ake cewa ya faru a cikin shekaru na 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, a kan hanyoyin sadarwar gidajen talabijin guda shida.

rows.output: A halin yanzu, rikicin siyasa ya ci gaba, tare da masu watsa shirye-shirye suna katse shirye-shiryen yau da kullun don kammalawar ranar Juma'a: wani yarjejeniya da 'yan majalisar Amurka Jeff Flake suka shirya don 'yan sanda suka gudanar da bincike na mako guda kan zargin.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake cikin haka, rikicin siyasar ya ci gaba, tare da masu yada labarai suna katsse shirin da ake yi na kullum don wani sauyi da aka yi na ranar Jumu’a a makare: wata yarjejeniya da Sanatan Arizona Jeff Flake ya haifar don Hukumar FBI ta yi wani bincike na mako guda na tuhume-tuhumen.

rows.output: Ford ta gaya wa kwamitin shari'ar shari'a na majalisar dattawan Amurka cewa tana da kaso 100 na tabbas cewa Kavanaugh ya taɓa ta da hannu ba tare da izinin ta ba, kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin cire mata kayan sawa a wani biki na makaranta.

rows.output: Tashar Fox News, wanda masu gabatar da ra'ayoyin su sun goyi bayan nada Kavanaugh sosai, ya jagoranci dukkan tashoshin da masu kallo miliyan 5.69 a lokacin duk ranar da aka yi wa shari'ar, in ji Nielsen.

rows.output: Ní báyìí, ìdúróṣinṣin òṣèlú náà tẹ̀síwájú, pẹ̀lú àwọn olùgbọ́ ìròyìn tí ń fọ́kù sí ètò ìtàgé fún ìyípadà ìkẹyìn ní ọjọ́ Jimọ: ìpinnu tí Sénátọ̀ Arizona Jeff Flake ṣe fún FBI láti ṣe ìwádìí ọ̀sẹ̀ kan lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà.
